validation.passwordRule: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number

auth.hero: Attendance made simple, accurate and accountable.
auth.heroSub: Track every class session, keep students informed and generate reports in seconds.
auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to your account to continue
auth.forgotSubtitle: Enter your email and we will send a reset link.
auth.linkSent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link has been sent. The link is valid for 1 hour.
auth.resetSubtitle: Choose a new password for your account.

dashboard.lowAttendance: Your attendance is below the required {{min}}%. Please contact your class monitor.

students.subtitle: Manage student records and class enrolment
students.importHelp: Upload a .csv or .xlsx file with these columns (max 1000 rows). Accounts get a random temporary password.
students.credentialsHint: Temporary passwords are shown only once. Download them now.
students.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate {{name}}? They will no longer be able to sign in. Attendance history is kept.
students.tempPasswordHint: A temporary password is generated and shown once.

classes.subtitle: Create classes, assign students and manage schedules
classes.archiveConfirm: Archive {{name}}? It will be hidden but its attendance data is kept.

monitors.subtitle: Create monitor accounts and assign them to classes

attendance.startSubtitle: Open a session for your class, mark every student and submit.
attendance.submitConfirm: Submit this session? {{n}} unmarked student(s) will be marked absent. Submitted sessions are locked; changes then need a correction request.
attendance.lockedNotice: This session is submitted and locked.
attendance.requestCorrectionLink: Request a correction from the history page
attendance.auditNotice: This record is locked. Your change is saved in the audit log and the student is notified.

corrections.subtitle: Review attendance correction requests
corrections.howStudent: To request a correction, open My Attendance History or the Calendar and choose the record.
corrections.reasonHint: Explain why the record is wrong (min. 5 characters)

reports.subtitle: Filter, review and export attendance data
reports.rules: Only submitted sessions are counted. Excused sessions: {{policy}}.

analytics.subtitle: Trends and comparisons across classes and time

users.subtitle: Manage accounts, roles and access
users.resetConfirm: Generate a new temporary password for {{name}}? Their current sessions will be signed out.

audit.subtitle: Every sensitive change and sign-in is recorded here

settings.subtitle: School information, attendance rules and academic calendar
settings.lateCounts: Late counts as present in the percentage
settings.lateAfterHint: Check-in later than start + N minutes becomes Late
settings.languagesNote: Supported interface languages: English and Khmer.
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Please sign in again.

announcements.subtitle: News from your administrators and class monitor
announcements.title: Title

notif.attendance_submitted: Attendance submitted for {{className}} on {{date}}: {{present}} present, {{late}} late, {{absent}} absent.
notif.student_marked_absent: You were marked absent in {{className}} on {{date}}.
notif.attendance_corrected: Your attendance on {{date}} was corrected to {{status}}.

profile.subtitle: Your account details
profile.contactHint: You can update your phone and address. Other details are managed by the school.
